items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer and Steve Wilson thanking him. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Steve was interviewed in Clinton, New York on October 25, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive on the Hamilton campus and I’m very pleased to have Steve Wilson with me today, and welcome to the college.
Thank you. Nice to be here.
